list_findings.title: List vulnerability findings
list_findings.description: Read Inspector's findings, filtered and sorted. `filter_criteria` is how you narrow to what matters -- severity, resource type, fix availability, exploit status -- and without it you get everything, which on a large account is a lot. A POST despite being a read.

filter_criteria.description: Which findings to return, as field names to comparison lists -- e.g. {"severity": [{"comparison": "EQUALS", "value": "CRITICAL"}], "fixAvailable": [{"comparison": "EQUALS", "value": "YES"}]}.

max_results.description: How many findings to return per page (1-100).

next_token.description: Token from a previous response, to fetch the next page.

output.description: A page of findings and the token for the next page.

list_finding_aggregations.title: Aggregate findings
list_finding_aggregations.description: Roll findings up by account, repository, image, package, title, EC2 instance or Lambda function. This is the reporting view -- "which packages account for our critical findings" -- rather than the raw list.

aggregation_request.description: Type-specific options, keyed by the aggregation type -- e.g. {"packageAggregation": {"sortBy": "CRITICAL"}}.

account_ids.description: Restrict to these AWS account ids, each with a comparison.

output.description: The aggregated counts and the token for the next page.

get_finding_details.title: Get full detail for findings
get_finding_details.description: Read the extended detail for up to 10 findings by ARN -- evidence, exploit observations and the CISA known-exploited status. The justification for prioritising one finding over another.

finding_arns.description: ARNs of the findings to expand, at most 10.

output.description: The detailed findings and any that could not be read.

get_code_snippet.title: Get the code behind a finding
get_code_snippet.description: Read the source snippet a code-security finding refers to, for up to 10 findings. Only meaningful for Lambda code and code-repository findings.

finding_arns.description: ARNs of the findings whose code you want, at most 10.

output.description: The code snippets and any errors.

search_vulnerabilities.title: Search the vulnerability database
search_vulnerabilities.description: Look a CVE up in Inspector's vulnerability intelligence -- description, CVSS scores, affected packages and whether it is known to be exploited. Answers "how bad is this CVE" independently of your own findings.

filter_criteria.description: Which vulnerabilities to look up, e.g. {"vulnerabilityIds": ["CVE-2024-3094"]}.

output.description: The matching vulnerabilities and the token for the next page.

list_coverage.title: List scanned resources
list_coverage.description: Read which resources Inspector is covering and which it is not. The answer to "why does this instance have no findings" -- an unscanned resource looks exactly like a clean one if you only read findings.

filter_criteria.description: Which resources to report on, e.g. {"resourceType": [{"comparison": "EQUALS", "value": "AWS_EC2_INSTANCE"}], "scanStatusCode": [{"comparison": "EQUALS", "value": "INACTIVE"}]}.

max_results.description: How many resources to return per page (1-200).

output.description: The covered resources with their scan status, plus the next-page token.

get_coverage_statistics.title: Get coverage statistics
get_coverage_statistics.description: Read counts of covered and uncovered resources, grouped by account, resource type, scan status or ECR repository -- the summary behind list_coverage.

filter_criteria.description: Which resources to count, in the same shape list_coverage takes.

group_by.description: What to group the counts by.

output.description: Counts per group and the total.

get_clusters_for_image.title: Find clusters running a container image
get_clusters_for_image.description: Read which ECS or EKS clusters are running a given container image -- how you turn an image-level finding into the workloads actually exposed to it.

filter.description: Which image to look for, e.g. {"resourceId": "<ECR image ARN>"}.

get_account_status.title: Get Inspector's status for accounts
get_account_status.description: Read whether Inspector is enabled per account and per scan type -- EC2, ECR, Lambda, code. The first call when nothing is being scanned.

account_ids.description: AWS account ids to check. Defaults to the calling account.

output.description: Per-account status for each scan type.

enable_scanning.title: Enable Inspector scanning
enable_scanning.description: Turn Inspector on for the given accounts and resource types. **This starts charging** -- Inspector bills per scanned resource -- and begins scanning immediately.

account_ids.description: Accounts to enable it for. Defaults to the calling account.

client_token.description: Your own idempotency token, so a retry cannot double-enable.

output.description: Which accounts were enabled and any that failed.

disable_scanning.title: Disable Inspector scanning
disable_scanning.description: Turn Inspector off for the given accounts and resource types. Scanning stops and the affected findings are archived, so vulnerability history stops accruing -- a security decision, not just a cost one.

account_ids.description: Accounts to disable it for. Defaults to the calling account.

resource_types.description: Which scan types to disable. Omit to disable all of them.

output.description: Which accounts were disabled and any that failed.

get_configuration.title: Get the account's scan configuration
get_configuration.description: Read the account's ECR rescan duration and EC2 configuration -- how long images keep being rescanned, and whether deep inspection is on.

account_id.description: The account to read. Defaults to the calling account.

update_configuration.title: Update the account's scan configuration
update_configuration.description: Change ECR rescan duration or EC2 scan mode. Widening the rescan window increases both coverage and cost; switching EC2 scan mode changes whether agentless scanning is used.

account_id.description: The account to configure. Defaults to the calling account.

get_ec2_deep_inspection_configuration.title: Get EC2 deep inspection settings
get_ec2_deep_inspection_configuration.description: Read whether deep inspection is active and which package paths it searches -- deep inspection finds vulnerabilities in application libraries, not just the OS.

output.description: The deep inspection status and package paths.

update_ec2_deep_inspection_configuration.title: Update EC2 deep inspection settings
update_ec2_deep_inspection_configuration.description: Turn EC2 deep inspection on or off and set the package paths it scans. Activating it increases what is scanned, and therefore both findings and cost.

package_paths.description: Extra filesystem paths to scan for application packages.

list_account_permissions.title: List the account's Inspector permissions
list_account_permissions.description: Read which Inspector actions the calling account is permitted, per service. The honest answer before blaming an operation for failing.

service.description: Restrict to one service, e.g. "EC2", "ECR" or "LAMBDA".

list_usage_totals.title: List Inspector usage and cost
list_usage_totals.description: Read usage totals per account -- how many instances, images and functions were scanned, and the estimated cost. What to check before and after enabling a scan type.

account_ids.description: Accounts to report on. Defaults to the calling account.

output.description: Usage and estimated cost per account.

get_free_trial_info.title: Get free trial status
get_free_trial_info.description: Read where each account stands in its Inspector free trial, per scan type -- how many days remain before charges begin.

output.description: Free trial status per account and scan type.

list_members.title: List member accounts
list_members.description: Read the member accounts associated with this delegated administrator, with each one's association status.

only_associated.description: Only return accounts currently associated. Defaults to true.

get_member.title: Get a member account
get_member.description: Read one member account's association status and delegated administrator.

associate_member.title: Associate a member account
associate_member.description: Bring an account under this delegated administrator, so its findings and coverage are visible centrally. Inspector must be enabled separately for it to scan anything.

disassociate_member.title: Disassociate a member account
disassociate_member.description: Remove an account from this delegated administrator. Its findings stop appearing centrally, though scanning in that account continues.

describe_organization_configuration.title: Get the organization configuration
describe_organization_configuration.description: Read whether Inspector auto-enables each scan type for new accounts joining the organization -- which decides whether new accounts arrive scanned or blind.

output.description: The auto-enable settings and whether they cover the whole organization.

update_organization_configuration.title: Update the organization configuration
update_organization_configuration.description: Set which scan types are enabled automatically for accounts joining the organization. This commits future accounts to scanning, and to its cost.

auto_enable.description: Which scan types to auto-enable, e.g. {"ec2": true, "ecr": true, "lambda": false, "lambdaCode": false}.

list_delegated_admin_accounts.title: List delegated administrator accounts
list_delegated_admin_accounts.description: Read which accounts are Inspector delegated administrators for the organization.

enable_delegated_admin_account.title: Make an account the delegated administrator
enable_delegated_admin_account.description: Designate an account as Inspector's delegated administrator for the organization -- it then sees every member's findings.

disable_delegated_admin_account.title: Remove the delegated administrator
disable_delegated_admin_account.description: Remove an account's delegated administrator role. Central visibility of member findings goes with it.

list_filters.title: List findings filters
list_filters.description: Read the saved filters on the account. A filter with action SUPPRESS is hiding findings from the default view -- worth auditing when the findings count looks suspiciously low.

create_filter.title: Create a findings filter
create_filter.description: Save a filter. With `action` of SUPPRESS it **hides matching findings** from the default view and from most reports -- an accepted-risk decision, not a display preference, so put the justification in `reason`.

action.description: "NONE" saves the filter for reuse; "SUPPRESS" hides matching findings from the default view.

filter_criteria.description: What the filter matches, in the same shape list_findings takes.

reason.description: Why matching findings are being suppressed -- the audit trail.

tags.description: Tags to put on the filter.

update_filter.title: Update a findings filter
update_filter.description: Change a filter's criteria or action. Turning `action` to SUPPRESS on an existing filter hides everything it matches from that moment.

filter_criteria.description: New criteria, replacing the old ones.

delete_filter.title: Delete a findings filter
delete_filter.description: Delete a filter. If it was suppressing findings, they reappear in the default view -- which is usually what you want, but expect the count to jump.

create_findings_report.title: Export a findings report
create_findings_report.description: Queue an export of findings to S3. The bucket must already grant Inspector write access and the KMS key must allow it to encrypt -- those two permissions are the usual cause of a failed report. Poll get_findings_report_status for the outcome.

s3_destination.description: Where to write it -- {"bucketName": ..., "keyPrefix": ..., "kmsKeyArn": ...}. All three matter: Inspector must be able to write and to encrypt.

filter_criteria.description: Which findings to include, in the same shape list_findings takes.

get_findings_report_status.title: Get a findings report's status
get_findings_report_status.description: Poll an export until it completes or fails. A failure here names the bucket or key problem behind it.

output.description: The report's status, destination and any error.

cancel_findings_report.title: Cancel a findings report
cancel_findings_report.description: Stop an export that is still running. Anything already written to S3 stays.

create_sbom_export.title: Export an SBOM
create_sbom_export.description: Queue a software bill of materials export to S3, in CycloneDX or SPDX format -- the inventory a vulnerability question is asked against. Same S3 and KMS permission requirements as a findings report.

resource_filter_criteria.description: Which resources to include, as an Inspector resource filter.

get_sbom_export.title: Get an SBOM export's status
get_sbom_export.description: Poll an SBOM export until it completes, and read where it was written.

cancel_sbom_export.title: Cancel an SBOM export
cancel_sbom_export.description: Stop an SBOM export that is still running.

list_cis_scans.title: List CIS benchmark scans
list_cis_scans.description: Read the CIS benchmark scans that have run against EC2 instances, with their status and pass/fail counts. Separate from vulnerability scanning: this is configuration hardening.

filter_criteria.description: Which scans to return, as a CIS scan filter.

detail_level.description: How much detail to include per scan.

list_cis_scan_configurations.title: List CIS scan configurations
list_cis_scan_configurations.description: Read the CIS scan schedules -- which instances are benchmarked, against which level, and how often.

create_cis_scan_configuration.title: Create a CIS scan configuration
create_cis_scan_configuration.description: Schedule CIS benchmark scans against tagged EC2 instances. Scans run on the instances themselves through SSM, so they consume resources on the targets at the scheduled time.

scan_name.description: A name for the scan configuration.

security_level.description: Which CIS benchmark level to test against.

tags.description: Tags to put on the configuration.

get_cis_scan_report.title: Get a CIS scan report
get_cis_scan_report.description: Read the report for one CIS scan -- which checks passed and failed on each instance.

target_accounts.description: Restrict the report to these accounts.

output.description: The report or a url to it.

list_cis_scan_results_by_check.title: List CIS results by check
list_cis_scan_results_by_check.description: Read a CIS scan's results grouped by check -- which hardening controls are failing across the fleet, which is how remediation gets prioritised.

delete_cis_scan_configuration.title: Delete a CIS scan configuration
delete_cis_scan_configuration.description: Delete a CIS scan schedule. Existing scan results remain readable; no further scans run.

list_code_security_integrations.title: List code security integrations
list_code_security_integrations.description: Read the source-code integrations -- GitHub, GitLab -- Inspector scans repositories through.

list_code_security_scan_configurations.title: List code security scan configurations
list_code_security_scan_configurations.description: Read the code-scanning configurations -- which repositories are scanned, for what (SAST, secrets, IaC), and on which events.

start_code_security_scan.title: Start a code security scan
start_code_security_scan.description: Scan a repository now rather than waiting for its trigger. The scan runs against the integration's connected repository.

resource.description: Which repository to scan, e.g. {"projectId": "<repo id>"}.

output.description: The started scan's id and status.

get_code_security_scan.title: Get a code security scan
get_code_security_scan.description: Read one code scan's status and summary.

resource.description: The repository the scan ran against.

output.description: The scan's status and findings summary.

list_tags_for_resource.title: List an Inspector resource's tags
list_tags_for_resource.description: Read the tags on an Inspector resource such as a filter or scan configuration.

tag_resource.title: Tag an Inspector resource
tag_resource.description: Add or replace tags on an Inspector resource.

untag_resource.title: Remove tags from an Inspector resource
untag_resource.description: Remove tags by key from an Inspector resource. Tag-based automation elsewhere may depend on them, so check before pruning.
